topic: Construct, test and observe output on voice transmission using amplitude modulation and demodulation on optical fiber communication trainer.
syllabus_extract: Construct, test and observe output on voice transmission using amplitude modulation and demodulation on optical fiber communication trainer.
specific_objectives: 30.1.1.1 Trainee should be able to practical on various lab FTL, RF & Embedded lab.

practical: Construction of AM circuit, testing voice transmission, observing demodulated output, safety precautions regarding high voltage and optical sources, instructor supervision during setup and operation.
intro_questions: What is the basic principle of Amplitude Modulation?
How does an optical fiber communication system transmit data?
What are the safety precautions when handling optical fiber components?
